verdicts.reason: Welcome and first-visit question is a sensible reply to a booking request.
User confirmed first visit; asking what they need help with follows naturally.
User answered the help question; moving on to doctor preference is a sensible next step.
Ignores the user: they clearly named a doctor, but the bot says it did not catch that and re-asks.
Asks what was already answered: user repeated the doctor name clearly and the bot re-asks again.
User had just answered clearly with the doctor name, so the call-customer-care fallback does not fit.
